name: Mallary
description: Connect Claude to Mallary to manage social media in one chat. See connected social media accounts, create or schedule posts on multiple platforms, use a different title/message for each platform, check publishing status, read your comments and ask Claude to write and send replies, view analytics, and manage profiles, settings, and webhooks. Mallary asks for approval before any action that can change a live account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mallary to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mallary to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mallary.ai/mcp/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mallary MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mallary lists 19 MCP tools, including mallary_attach_tiktok_post_url, mallary_create_post, mallary_create_profile, mallary_create_upload_url, mallary_create_webhook, mallary_delete_post, mallary_delete_webhook, mallary_disconnect_platform, mallary_get_analytics, mallary_get_job, mallary_get_settings, and mallary_list_comments.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mallary?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mallary in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Mallary requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mallary is developed by Mallary.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
